title: Wauren & Wadison
about: A sleep-deprived 3 A.M. Wuzzles session where Lauren became Wauren and Madison became Wadison.
description: This track remembers one of the smallest and funniest moments from my final year as an Assistant Director. Near the end of the 2023 fair, Lauren and I were still in the SAI office around 3:00 A.M. preparing Wuzzles for the next morning. After days of long hours, exhaustion had thoroughly taken over, and replacing the first letters of names with W suddenly seemed hilarious. Lauren became Wauren, Madison became Wadison, and the Wuzzles somehow still got finished. Nobody the next morning needed to know how exhausted we actually were, but the private joke became one of the memories that stayed with me from that final year.
lyrics: The fair was winding slowly down,
Most everyone had found a bed,
The office lights were still awake,
At three o'clock beneath their glow.
The clock kept ticking, pages turned,
Where nothing sounds the way it should be.
If it's got a name, we'll fix it somehow,
Makes perfect sense... well, not right now.
A world where every name has changed.
Every clue looked twice as hard
Just laughter echoing off the walls.
Trying not to let tomorrow know
We still had to look refreshed
So all the sleepy jokes stayed hidden,
Where nothing sounds the way it should be.
At least to us back then.
Three in the morning writes its own rules,
Until the sun comes up again.
That stick around the longest time.
The ones that never make the headlines.
Over something nobody else would see.
Don't ask exactly when or how.
Had turned into the land of W's again.
And somehow... everything started with W.
